title: Aedan Looking Glass and Magnom Properties announce US$750mln Pinnacle Data Center at Forbes International Tower, Egypt
summary: Strategic collaboration with Trinidy AI and Turnkey Capital will establish advanced computing and digital infrastructure capabilities in The New Capital’s tower
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
WASHINGTON, D.C. — Magnom Properties, developer of Forbes International Tower and onboarding member of Forbes Global Properties, and U.S.-based Aedan Looking Glass (ALG) announce a strategic partnership to support the development of Pinnacle Data Center, an advanced computing and digital infrastructure facility to be housed within the landmark tower. Located in Egypt's New Capital, Forbes International Tower sets a new benchmark for intelligent building technology and environmentally-responsive architecture, positioned to become the world’s first skyscraper to register for International Living Future Institute’s Zero Carbon Certificate. 

The agreement was formalized on November 10, 2026, in Washington, D.C. The signing coincided with B20 USA, an annual forum that aligns international real estate development and U.S. technology stakeholders to address the growing demand for high-performance computing, artificial intelligence infrastructure, and secure enterprise digital services.  

Serving as the digital backbone of Forbes International Tower, Pinnacle Data Center brings together the expertise of Magnom Properties, ALG, Trinidy AI, and Turnkey Capital Inc. (OTC: TKCI). Trinidy AI will serve as the data center operator, overseeing facility design, development, and ongoing operations, including the delivery of advanced AI computing services. ALG will lead technology and infrastructure delivery, while Turnkey Capital will participate as a strategic partner supporting the project's broader technology and infrastructure objectives. 

Pinnacle Data Center is being developed under a long-term commercial framework that aligns ALG’s investment in the facility with Magnom Properties’ long-term ownership of Forbes International Tower. Under that framework, ALG funds and delivers the facility, and Magnom Properties has a defined path to bring it fully within the tower’s ownership. 

Designed by Adrian Smith + Gordon Gill Architecture, Forbes International Tower will incorporate clean hydrogen energy, integrated solar technologies, intelligent building systems, and advanced security infrastructure. Aligning with the tower's broader environmental objectives, Pinnacle Data Center’s proposed design incorporates AI-driven energy management, modular infrastructure, and intelligent power and cooling systems to optimize operational efficiency and reduce unnecessary energy consumption. 

“Forbes International Tower represents a new generation of financial centers, integrating sustainable development, global business, and advanced digital infrastructure. As per Fitch’s August 2021 forecast, Egypt’s economy was projected to approach USD 1 trillion by 2030. Forbes International Tower is being developed to support this economic potential by connecting international capital with AI capabilities and high-value financial services, strengthening Egypt’s role as a regional hub for finance and the digital economy said Maged Marie, CEO, Magnom Properties, an onboarding member of Forbes Global Properties, operating as Egypt Forbes Global Properties.  

As demand for artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and secure digital services continues to grow, the initiative reflects an opportunity to develop critical technology infrastructure with energy efficiency, resilience, and long-term sustainability in mind. 

“The Pinnacle Data Center brings together American technology expertise and international investment to establish critical computing infrastructure in one of the region’s most significant commercial developments,” said Eric Fitzgerald, Chairman of Aedan Looking Glass. “Our role is to deliver the technology and infrastructure needed to support secure, scalable AI computing operations. This partnership represents a significant step in expanding U.S. technology capabilities into international markets while supporting Egypt’s growing digital economy.” 

“The Forbes name has long been associated with people shaping the global business landscape.  Forbes International Tower brings that legacy into the built environment, with the advanced digital infrastructure that these leaders increasingly require.” Michael Jalbert, CEO of Forbes Global Properties. “We are proud to be a part of this landmark project and to support the growth of Egypt’s New Capital.” 

By integrating advanced computing capabilities within a landmark commercial development, the initiative seeks to demonstrate how real estate, technology, and digital infrastructure can work together to support the next generation of enterprise activity. 

“The Pinnacle Data Center represents an opportunity to build a world-class AI computing facility designed to meet the demands of today while also anticipating the demands of tomorrow,” said Clifford Cruz, CEO of Trinidy AI. “As the data center operator, our focus is on delivering efficient, scalable infrastructure that supports the growing demand for AI computing while creating lasting economic value for the region and strengthening the country's technology infrastructure.” 

About Forbes International Tower

Forbes International Tower is a landmark commercial development in Egypt’s New Capital, developed by Magnom Properties in partnership with Forbes and designed by Adrian Smith + Gordon Gill Architecture. Encompassing approximately 100,000 square meters, the tower combines distinctive architectural design with advanced building technologies and digital infrastructure, including Pinnacle Data Center. With an intended net-zero carbon footprint, Forbes International Tower will establish a new benchmark for sustainable, technology-driven properties. 

About Magnom Properties

Magnom Properties is a subsidiary of Rawabi Saudi Holding, a diversified regional conglomerate with interests spanning construction, transportation, logistics, energy, and infrastructure. Established in 2021, Magnom Properties specializes in premium real estate development, including commercial, residential, hospitality, and luxury retail projects. Guided by its core pillars of luxury, sustainability, technology, and art, the company collaborates with leading international architects, designers, and technology partners to create landmark developments that combine innovative design with environmental responsibility. Its flagship Forbes International Tower project in Egypt's New Capital embodies this approach, bringing together architectural distinction, smart building technologies, and an ambitious net-zero carbon vision. For more information, visit magnomproperties.com. 

About Aedan Looking Glass (ALG)

Aedan Looking Glass (ALG) is a U.S.-based intelligence and scientific research company developing advanced technology solutions for government, private-sector, and enterprise applications. The company's capabilities span adaptive intelligence, advanced security, automated defense systems, and modular data and computing infrastructure. ALG develops systems across defense, energy, communications, and critical infrastructure, with an emphasis on security, resilience, and performance in mission-critical environments. For more information, visit aedan.io. 

About Turnkey Capital Inc.

Turnkey Capital Inc. (OTC: TKCI) is a publicly traded technology company focused on advancing adaptive technologies through intellectual property development, strategic partnerships, licensing, and commercial deployment opportunities. Its portfolio spans adaptive intelligence, modular data centers, automated defense systems, and cybersecurity, with a strategy centered on expanding the commercial applications of proprietary technologies. For more information, visit tkci.ai.  

About Trinidy AI Corporation

Trinidy is a U.S.-based artificial intelligence infrastructure company redefining how enterprises access, deploy, and scale AI computing. The company specializes in private AI inference infrastructure, combining its proprietary virtualization technology with high-performance computing systems to deliver secure, dedicated AI computing capacity at scale. Through its Nexus OS AI Hypervisor and hardware-agnostic architecture, Trinidy enables organizations to deploy and operate AI workloads with greater control, predictable costs, and improved infrastructure efficiency. Beyond its AI computing platform, Trinidy provides data center design, development, and operational expertise, integrating physical infrastructure with advanced computing technologies to support the growing global demand for AI. For more information, visit  trinidy.com.  

About Forbes Global Properties 

Led by the world’s foremost independent residential brokers and industry veterans, Forbes Global Properties is the exclusive real estate partner of Forbes. Our members connect discerning buyers and sellers of the most exceptional properties worldwide. Leveraging Forbes’s worldwide reach and digital monthly audience of more than 167 million, our listings tell the stories that make our properties unique. Established in 2020, our invitation-only network spans more than 600 locations and comprises over 20,000 property experts across the U.S., South America, Asia, Australia, Africa, Canada, the Caribbean, Mexico, the Middle East, New Zealand, and Europe. For more information, visit forbesglobalproperties.com.
